factor_diagnostics.value_notes: WDFW and DFO describe redtail surfperch primarily in the surf zone on exposed sandy beaches, with use of estuaries/bays and reported shallow depth to about 7 m. This supports the 1-15 m shallow coastal band but does not validate the 3-10 m ideal as a measured preference.
